poses.caption: Sit on a bench and hinge forward with a flat back. Hold both dumbbells palms inward with elbows bent beside your torso.
Keep your upper arms still and extend the right forearm backward. Return slowly.
Extend the left forearm backward while the right elbow stays bent. Continue alternating.

poses.caption: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step forward into a controlled lunge and extend both arms overhead, keeping elbows near your ears.
Hold the lunge and bend both elbows to lower the weights behind your head. Extend again, finish your repetitions and switch legs.
